verdict.rationale: Marqeta's MCP server lets external AI agents query and analyze payment activity via natural language ('Transaction intelligence: Query, analyze, and monitor payment activity through natural language interactions'), which enables AI-generated insights from Marqeta data, but this is delivered through a developer-facing agent integration rather than a native in-product AI assistant or dashboard. Missing for 10: evidence of a built-in UI-level AI insights/suggestions feature, concrete examples of generated insights, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP-driven analysis working end-to-end.
